main_text.p: שָׁכַךְ Sedari, Quiescere: item Ponere, Tendere retia. Hiphil הָשְׁכִּיךְ Fecit quiescere, Sepofuit, Avertit:
שָׁכַל Orbari. Pihel שִׁכֵּל Orbare: item Abortire. Hiphil הִשְׁכִּיל idem.
שִׁכּוּל m. Orbatus. שָׁכוֹל m. Orbitas.
אִשְׁכּוֹל m. Botrus, Bacca: plur. אֶשְׁכּוֹלוֹת.

שָׂכַל Secundari, Prosperari. Pihel שִׂכֵּל Scitè agere vel cognoscere. Hiphil הִשְׂכִּיל Intelligere, Intelligentem esse vel fieri; Animadvertere, Attendere: & activè Intelligentem reddere, Erudire, Instruere: item Secundari, Prosperari. Chal. ex Ithp. Part. מִשְׂתַּכֵּל הוֹית Considerans eram, Dan. 7.8.
הַשְּׂכֵל שֵׂכֶל m. Intellectus, Intelligentia, Prudentia; Successus.
שָׂכְלְתָנוּ f. Chald. Intelligentia, Dan. 5.17, per usitatam apocopam literæ ת.
וּשְׂכַלְלָה Et perfecerat eam, Esr.5.11. Infinit.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are approximate where the scan is faint. The entry "וְשׁוּרִיא" at the start of the Chald. entry is doubtful. Running head is Hebrew "שכ", as printed. Page number 351 is read from the top left and may be faint.
